verdict.rationale: Semgrep's AI layer, Semgrep Assistant, post-processes findings in context to cut noise by about 20%, which amounts to flagging likely false positives (semgrep-gh-3). The homepage markets AI reasoning for triage (semgrep-docs-48), and a community user built LLM-based prioritization on Semgrep's SARIF output (semgrep-comm-14), though that relied on an external, non-first-party tool. missing for 10: documented AI explanations of findings, AI deduplication of findings, in-depth first-party docs on Assistant's triage workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of Assistant's false-positive flagging.
